title: Task inbox
status: gate met - AC-1..AC-6 met: a missing deadline is unscheduled, an unconfirmed timestamp is never overdue, every tab's count matches its grid, a missing source record is a broken link, a newer load discards the earlier one, and a deadline is shown in UTC and the company zone. The inbox also consumes the LSE-03 expiring-lease tasks, closing LSE-03 AC-3.

dataModel.table: CROSS_PERSONA_TASK (LifeCycle-owned) gained DUE_CONFIRMED_IND: 'Y' only when the deadline's zone is confirmed. Everything else (persona, role, state, entity, route) already existed.
dataModel.leaseProjection: The expiring-lease tasks are not copied into CROSS_PERSONA_TASK; the inbox merges the LSE-03 projection at read time, so the lease set stays owned by LeaseAcquisition and no second copy can drift.

implementation.page: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop/Views/TaskInboxPageView.cs (route 'tasks', replacing the placeholder: queue tabs, grid, detail, open source, broken-link refusal)
implementation.wiring: OgBootstrapper (IOgTaskInbox), OgApplication.TaskInbox, existing catalog 'tasks' entry (OgModuleKeys.Core), OgPageFactory, existing en + ar labels
implementation.tests: test/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Tests/TaskInboxTests.cs (7, no database) + TaskInboxGatewayTests.cs (1 opt-in, real SQLite)

integration.database: SQLite with CROSS_PERSONA_TASK and the lease tables, seeded in TaskInboxGatewayTests
integration.persona: T-5 is assigned to Driller and is absent from the Accountant inbox; T-1..T-4 are present
integration.ac1_unscheduled: T-2 has no deadline, is in the Unscheduled tab, and the counts are Today 0 / Overdue 1 / Unscheduled 1 / All 5 / Broken 1
integration.ac2_unconfirmed: T-3 has a past timestamp with DUE_CONFIRMED_IND='N': it is not in Overdue, is flagged Unconfirmed, and its DueText says 'time zone unconfirmed'
integration.ac3_counts: the Overdue tab grid is exactly T-1 and its count is 1; Unscheduled is exactly T-2; every tab predicate is the same one Count uses
integration.ac4_broken: T-4 names a LEASE_ACQUISITION id that does not exist: SourceExists=false and BrokenText says 'source record not found'
integration.ac5_persona: TaskInboxTests starts two loads: the first version is not current and is discarded; the page checks IsCurrent after the await before rendering
integration.ac6_zone: a confirmed deadline renders '2026-06-01 09:00 UTC (2026-06-01 12:00 CompanyZone)' with a custom company zone
integration.lse03_ac3: the lease L-1 expiry 2026-07-15 is merged as a LEASE_EXPIRY task with route 'leasefinancials', source exists, so the LSE-03 expiring set is consumed by the inbox

gates.AC-1 A missing deadline appears as unsch: pass - OgTask.Unscheduled and the Unscheduled filter; the unit and SQLite tests both prove a null DUE_DATE is unscheduled and absent from Overdue.
gates.AC-2 A timestamp without a confirmed zon: pass - DUE_CONFIRMED_IND gates the overdue predicate; an unconfirmed past timestamp is shown with the warning and is absent from Overdue.
gates.AC-3 Counts per tab match the filtered g: pass - Count and Filter use the same predicates; the unit test asserts every tab's count equals its grid and the SQLite test checks Overdue and Unscheduled.
gates.AC-4 A source record that cannot be foun: pass - a task whose ENTITY_TYPE is LEASE_ACQUISITION is checked against the acquisition table; a missing id is SourceExists=false, BrokenText is set, and Open source refuses to follow it.
gates.AC-5 A persona change reloads the inbox: pass - each load takes a version from BeginLoad and the page checks IsCurrent after the await; a newer load makes the earlier version stale and its result is not rendered.
gates.AC-6 Display shows both UTC and the comp: pass - a confirmed deadline is formatted as UTC plus the session TimeZoneId; the page passes OgSession.TimeZoneId.

limits: The task inbox page exists at route 'tasks', but the persona landing map is unchanged: WFL-05's 'default landing for every persona' is not switched, because that is FND-07's landing policy and would change the audited landing for every persona.

Process tasks are read from CROSS_PERSONA_TASK; the process engine that writes them (WFL-03/WFL-04) is a separate feature and is not built here. A task with an unknown ENTITY_TYPE is not marked broken because the inbox cannot check that type.
Bulk 'mark read' is not implemented: CROSS_PERSONA_TASK has no read flag and WFL-05's acceptance criteria do not require it; 'Open source' is the action.
The DUE_CONFIRMED_IND column is new: an existing database needs the LIFECYCLE module applied again (or an explicit column migration) to gain it.
The field filter applies to the lease tasks (the lease read is field-scoped); process tasks carry no field column, so they are not filtered by field.
